items.title: ChatGPT Ads vs. Google Search Ads: what early data shows
items.excerpt: Early data comparing ChatGPT Ads and Google Search ads: ChatGPT is competing for ad budgets, but its ad visits earned less in early data and per-dollar returns are still estimated; revenue and survey data don't yet show how much spend has left search.

items.title: New Google AdMob AI tools help app creators build, fix, and grow faster
items.excerpt: Google introduces Ask AdMob, a Gemini agent that uses peer benchmarks to flag setup errors, suggest SDK bidders and spot floor-price discrepancies, plus agent skills/MCP so coding agents can set up app ad monetization in code.

items.title: Lunio cuts Google brand bids when no rival is in the auction
items.excerpt: A Revvim-powered agentic bid tool from Lunio moves uncontested Google Search and Shopping brand clicks to a low-bid campaign within the hour, cutting brand-search spend when no competitor is bidding.

items.title: Google steers holiday hotel, dinner and ticket bookings into AI Mode
items.excerpt: Hotel rooms now book inside Google's AI Mode via Google Pay in the US with partners as merchant of record, and ticket drops get tracked too - pulling holiday purchase transactions into Google's AI surface.

items.title: Amazon's $78bn ad machine now sets the defaults agencies buy inside
items.excerpt: Analysis of how Amazon's AI-automated DVA+ defaults, a cheap DSP and Prime Video inventory are shifting budget control from agencies to Amazon itself.

items.title: J. Crew introduces AI-powered Style Advisor
items.excerpt: J. Crew launches a desktop AI Style Advisor built with Anthropic that goes beyond single-product search to deliver styled outfit recommendations ahead of the holidays.

items.title: Deloitte Digital's new agentic tools aim to fix messy marketing workflows
items.excerpt: Deloitte Digital's Converge by Front Office suite uses agents to link brands' existing marketing tools and data, responding to survey data that 76% of brand leaders say their foundations don't support AI value.

items.title: How Bustle Digital Group is helping Pampers and Innisfree show up in AI recommendations
items.excerpt: Bustle Digital Group has teamed with Profound to sell brands like Pampers and Innisfree a service that boosts their visibility in AI chatbot recommendations.

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Business Agent - first look
items.excerpt: Brand business agents built with ChatGPT Business Hub's agent builder (e.g. Chewy) are starting to appear inside ChatGPT, giving a first look at how customer-facing brand agents surface to shoppers.

items.title: Jordan Belfort's new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the 'Wolf of Wall Street'
items.excerpt: Belfort's Tone builds an AI sales voice agent he claims already closes deals almost as well as top human salespeople, and expects to catch up within a year.

items.title: 네이버 vs 카카오, AI 에이전트 경쟁 본격화…외부 서비스 연결 승부
items.excerpt: Naver and Kakao disclosed on Q3 calls that their AI agents will extend to external services, linking search through booking, purchase and payment to win transaction share.

items.title: LinkedIn says influential voices are critical for AI chatbot citations
items.excerpt: LinkedIn Ads' AI search marketing lead says AI models reward credibility, so B2B brands' executive and expert voices on LinkedIn drive citations in AI chatbots.
